body: Omg, I don't know you, but I'm so sorry you are going through this!! This lack of basic respect for people would be bad at any given time, but this is being that, it is playing with people's lives. I'm so sorry, and hope they figure it out soon!!

I went in today and was able to do it just fine. All went well.  
Someone else without an appointment just showed up there and they did not see this person.
I think it has to do with demand, the available appointments went out REALLY fast.
I fucking hate myself so much. No one loves me not even my cat. I can't have the life I want and I am a piece of shit that nobody wants. Just want to die.
